'''Vassek''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Vassek system/Legends|Vassek system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] maintained a [[Grievous's castle/Legends|castle]] on its [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]].
{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sources such as ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' and ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' incorrectly state that Grievous's castle was located on Vassek itself rather than on its [[Moon/Legends|moon]].
